title: The Perils of Narrowing Fiscal Spaces
title_zh: DP21773 财政空间收窄的风险
authors: Hanno Kase, Leonardo Melosi, Sebastian Rast, Matthias Rottner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a nonlinear model in which trend inflation and inflation tail risks emerge endogenously in equilibrium from the interaction between the primary deficit and the risk of supply disruptions. The key friction is limited fiscal responsibility: the government stabilizes debt in the long run but, unwilling to let debt accumulate too quickly, pressures the central bank to restrain interest-rate increases rather than adjust its own budget. The fiscal limit binds asymmetrically across shocks, with inflationary supply shocks especially likely to push monetary policy against the constraint. As supply-shock volatility rises and fiscal space narrows, the constraint binds more often. Anticipating this, agents raise their inflation expectations, causing trend inflation and upside inflation tail risks to rise even before the constraint binds. Movements in supply-shock volatility and fiscal space together account for much of the ratcheting up and down of U.S. trend inflation between 1965 and 1990. Interpreted through the model, the post-pandemic rise in long-run inflation expectations reflects a higher probability of fiscally constrained monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个非线性模型，其中趋势通胀与通胀尾部风险通过基本赤字与供给中断风险的相互作用在均衡中内生形成。核心摩擦在于有限财政责任：政府虽在长期内稳定债务，但因不愿让债务过快累积，转而施压央行限制利率上调而非调整自身预算。财政约束对不同冲击呈现非对称约束效应——通胀性供给冲击尤其容易迫使货币政策触碰该约束。随着供给冲击波动率上升与财政空间收窄，约束触发频率显著增加。预期到这一机制，经济主体提前上调通胀预期，导致趋势通胀与上行通胀尾部风险在约束实际生效前已然攀升。1965年至1990年间，供给冲击波动率与财政空间的协同变动，解释了美国趋势通胀大部分阶梯式升降现象。通过模型解读，后疫情时期长期通胀预期的上升，反映了财政约束型货币政策发生概率的提高。

title: Averting Mortality, Enabling Mobility: Health and Economic Impacts of HIV Treatment at Scale
title_zh: 规避死亡，促进流动：大规模HIV治疗的健康与经济影响
authors: Wang, Huan, Baranov, Victoria, Dickerson, Sarah, Barofsky, Jeremy
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) for HIV/AIDS has expanded rapidly across low-income countries since 2000, generating large gains in life expectancy. Exploiting spatial and temporal variation in ART availability, this paper examines the health and economic consequences of ART introduction across a comprehensive set of outcomes in rural Malawi, a low-income setting with high HIV prevalence. We find that ART substantially reduces prime-age mortality. Although these health gains raise individual prime-age labor supply, total household labor supply and household earnings are unchanged. We show that this divergence reflects the outward migration of prime-age household members, particularly men. Consistent with this mechanism, households receive sizable increases in remittances. Our findings identify migration as an important, but previously overlooked channel through which health shapes household economic outcomes.
abstract_zh: 自2000年以来，低收入国家针对HIV/AIDS的抗逆转录病毒疗法（ART）迅速普及，显著提升了预期寿命。本文利用马拉维农村地区（一个HIV感染率高、收入水平低的地区）ART可及性的时空差异，系统考察了该疗法引入对一系列健康与经济结果的影响。研究发现，ART显著降低了壮年人口死亡率。尽管这一健康改善提高了个人壮年劳动力供给，但家庭总劳动力供给与家庭收入并未发生变化。研究表明，这种分化源于壮年家庭成员（尤其是男性）的外迁。与这一机制相符的是，家庭收到的汇款显著增加。我们的发现揭示了迁移作为健康影响家庭经济结果的重要渠道，而这一渠道此前未被充分关注。

title: Kalshi and the Rise of Macro Markets
title_zh: Kalshi与宏观市场的崛起
authors: Anthony M. Diercks, Jared Dean Katz, Jonathan H. Wright
abstract: Prediction markets offer a new market-based approach to measuring macroeconomic expectations in real-time. We evaluate the accuracy of prediction market-implied forecasts from Kalshi, the largest federally regulated prediction market overseen by the CFTC. We compare Kalshi with more traditional survey and market-implied forecasts, examine how expectations respond to macroeconomic and financial news, and how policy signals are interpreted by market participants. Our results suggest that Kalshi markets provide a high-frequency, continuously updated, distributionally rich benchmark that is valuable to both researchers and policymakers.
abstract_zh: 预测市场提供了一种基于市场的新方法，用于实时衡量宏观经济预期。我们评估了由CFTC监管的、美国最大的联邦监管预测市场Kalshi所隐含预测的准确性。我们将Kalshi与传统调查及市场隐含预测进行比较，考察预期如何对宏观经济和金融新闻做出反应，以及市场参与者如何解读政策信号。研究结果表明，Kalshi市场提供了一个高频、持续更新、分布信息丰富的基准，对研究人员和政策制定者均具有重要价值。

title: Climate and Feeding Strategies: An Analysis of Productivity Growth in New Zealand Dairy
title_zh: 气候与饲养策略：新西兰奶牛业生产率增长分析
authors: Mario Fernandez, Mark Neal, Gavan Dwyer
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: Productivity growth is essential for securing the long‐term profitability and competitiveness of pasture‐based dairy systems, particularly amid volatile input and output prices and increasing environmental constraints. This paper measures productivity growth using a total factor productivity index (TFPI) tailored to the seasonal, pasture‐based nature of New Zealand dairy farming. We apply a proper‐index approach to enable meaningful comparisons across time and farms. The TFPI is decomposed into key components: technological progress, scale and input‐mix efficiency, technical efficiency, production environment and statistical noise. To account for climate‐related variability, we integrate pasture growth indices as proxies for pasture availability supporting milksolids (fat + protein) production. Between 2012/2013 and 2023/2024, productivity growth plateaued, with the TFPI declining by 1.33% (−0.09% per annum). While technological progress increased by 6.9%, this was offset by declines in scale‐and‐mix efficiency (−4.2%), technical efficiency (−0.63%) and production environment favourability (−1.68%). Moreover, technological progress has stagnated since 2015/2016, suggesting that recent innovations have not translated into measurable productivity gains. These findings underscore the need for a multifaceted response to reverse productivity decline and secure competitiveness: accelerating innovation, strengthening technology adoption and building environmental resilience.
abstract_zh: 生产率增长对于确保放牧型奶牛养殖系统的长期盈利能力和竞争力至关重要，尤其是在投入品和产出品价格波动加剧以及环境约束日益严格的背景下。本文采用针对新西兰奶牛养殖季节性、放牧型特点的全要素生产率指数（TFPI）来测算生产率增长。我们运用恰当指数方法，以实现跨时间和跨农场的有效比较。TFPI被分解为关键组成部分：技术进步、规模与投入组合效率、技术效率、生产环境以及统计噪声。为考虑气候相关变异性，我们整合了牧草生长指数作为牧草可用性的代理变量，以支持乳固体（脂肪+蛋白质）生产。在2012/2013至2023/2024年间，生产率增长趋于停滞，TFPI下降1.33%（年均下降0.09%）。尽管技术进步增长了6.9%，但被规模与组合效率下降（-4.2%）、技术效率下降（-0.63%）以及生产环境有利性下降（-1.68%）所抵消。此外，自2015/2016年以来技术进步已停滞，表明近期创新并未转化为可衡量的生产率提升。这些发现凸显了需要采取多维度应对措施以扭转生产率下降并确保竞争力：加速创新、强化技术采纳以及构建环境韧性。

title: The Liquidity of the Government Bond Market—What Impact Does Quantitative Easing Have? Evidence from Sweden
title_zh: 政府债券市场的流动性——量化宽松有何影响？来自瑞典的证据
authors: MARIANNA BLIX GRIMALDI, ALBERTO CROSTA, DONG ZHANG
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: Quantitative easing (QE) introduced during the 2008 financial crisis, has since remained a key monetary policy tool. Our paper studies how QE affects market liquidity using unique data on Swedish government bonds. We find that there is a deterioration in the level of market liquidity from QE. This scarcity effect is nonlinear. Only after QE reaches a certain volume level, it outweighs the improvement in liquidity from boosting market demand. Unlike market prices, which often react to announcements, liquidity does not change when QE is announced. Instead, the liquidity effect occurs in connection with the actual purchases.
abstract_zh: 2008年金融危机期间引入的量化宽松政策（QE）此后一直是重要的货币政策工具。本文利用瑞典政府债券的独特数据，研究量化宽松如何影响市场流动性。我们发现量化宽松会导致市场流动性水平恶化。这种稀缺效应是非线性的：只有当量化宽松达到一定规模后，其对流动性的负面影响才会超过通过提振市场需求带来的改善效应。与通常对政策公告做出反应的市场价格不同，流动性在量化宽松宣布时并未发生变化，而是与实际购买行为相关联时才产生流动性效应。
